newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares reverse trend, close higher.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares reverse trend, close higher.

text.p: Late buying by domestic investors and speculators reversed an early downward trend as shares on the Delhi bourse closed higher on Wednesday, brokers said.
The bourse's sensitive index closed 6.41 points higher at 772.33.
"Emergence of buying at the fag end of the session averted crash like conditions on the Delhi bourse," said Harjit Thakur of brokers J.N. Kohli and Co.
Reliance Industries ended 3.35 rupees higher at 296.35.
State Bank of India recovered 2.20 rupees to 305.15.
Larsen and Toubro ended 2.90 rupees higher at 213.25.
